title: Goldman Sachs Announces Partner Class of 2026
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, November 5, 2026 –** Today, we are pleased to announce the Partner Class of 2026, a group of 109 individuals who have been invited to become partners of Goldman Sachs as of January 1, 2027, the start of our next fiscal year.


For more than 157 years, a steadfast commitment to serving our clients with excellence and a strong sense of partnership have been at the heart of Goldman Sachs’ culture. The Partner Class of 2026 reflects our commitment to elevating leaders who have distinguished themselves through their differentiated impact on our global franchise and ongoing focus on managing risk effectively, while consistently embodying our core values and actively investing in the growth and development of our people.


These decisions are extremely difficult, and we acknowledge the hard work of those who were not selected this year.


Please join us in congratulating the Partner Class of 2026.


David Solomon
John Waldron


**Partner Class of 2026**
